changelog: Compatibility: targets Jellyfin 12.0.0.0 stable release with plugin version 1.8.3.0. Fixes: resolves library manager item resolution when TopParentIds returns empty on Jellyfin 12, ensures robust path matching against selected libraries, filters valid item kinds, and clarifies pool storage modes.
description: Fill a local poster pool per movie from providers, then periodically rotate the Primary Poster image from the pool. This keeps Jellyfin looking fresh with rotating poster images on an interval of your choosing.
name: Poster Rotator
